fal-ai/nano-banana.note: sync_mode returns a data URI instead of a hosted file — irrelevant to a pipeline that downloads the result; limit_generations.default differs because we send the key explicitly rather than inheriting fal's.

fal-ai/nano-banana-2.note: sync_mode is a delivery mode we don't use; system_prompt and thinking_level steer the model's persona/reasoning, not asset generation — out of scope for text → image → 3D.

fal-ai/nano-banana-pro.note: sync_mode is a delivery mode we don't use; system_prompt is persona steering, not pipeline-relevant; limit_generations.default differs because we send the key explicitly.

fal-ai/flux-2.note: sync_mode is a delivery mode we don't use; enable_prompt_expansion rewrites the user's prompt behind their back, which our template system already owns; guidance_scale.min is a deliberate narrowing (ours 1.0 vs fal's 0 — a 0 guidance scale ignores the prompt entirely).

fal-ai/flux-2-pro.note: sync_mode returns a data URI instead of a hosted file — irrelevant to a pipeline that downloads the result.

fal-ai/trellis-2.note: The guidance-interval and uv_unwrap knobs are sampler/UV-chart internals with no user-facing meaning at our altitude; seed.min/max are a deliberate narrowing of an unbounded schema field to the u32 range the API actually accepts.

fal-ai/hunyuan-3d/v3.1/pro/image-to-3d.note: Extra-view image URLs: our pipeline produces exactly one image, so there is no second view to supply.

fal-ai/meshy/v6/image-to-3d.note: Rigging/animation duplicate our own bind + clip pipeline; enable_safety_checker is a provider-side policy toggle we don't expose; is_a_t_pose is deprecated in favour of pose_mode, which we do expose; texture_image_url needs a second image we don't have; model_type is deferred to planned conditional-parameter support (its values gate which other knobs apply, which our flat parameter model can't express yet). should_remesh.default differs because we send the key explicitly, so fal's default never applies.

fal-ai/meshy/v7/image-to-3d.note: Same rationale as the v6 wrapper. symmetry_mode is additionally listed here because v7 sends no body key for it (Meshy deprecated it API-wide: 'This parameter no longer affects output'), where the v6 body still carries it inert. ultra_mode is deprecated in fal's own schema ('Deprecated: use geometry_resolution=2k') and superseded by geometry_resolution, which we do expose. model_type is deferred to planned conditional-parameter support. should_remesh.default and geometry_resolution.default differ because we send both keys explicitly, so fal's defaults (true, and none at all) never apply.
